sentences.en: It is tossed by the waves, but does not sink.
sentences.zh: 它被海浪轻轻拍打，但没有沉下去。

sentences.en: I usually toss my loose change into my desk drawer.
sentences.zh: 我通常把零钱随手扔进抽屉里。

sentences.en: The coin toss decides who will kick off the match.
sentences.zh: 掷硬币决定了谁将先开球。

phrases.zh: 翻来覆去（形容难以入睡）
